exchanges: so i finally sat down after the longest morning at the garden we had the school kids come in to plant bulbs and of course i ended up teaching them like i never retired
Once a teacher, always a teacher. How did the kids like it?
they loved getting muddy the little ones especially one boy ate a worm or pretended to anyway
Every class has one of those.
esperanza who runs the garden was translating for two of the families who just arrived from manila she speaks Tagalog so she could explain everything to them
That must have made the families feel welcome.
it did they were so happy anyway after all that seun brought out lemonade for everyone
Very thoughtful. Is Seun one of the regular volunteers?
yes every saturday and she is pregnant with her first she's due in January so we keep telling her to sit down but she wont listen
She sounds determined. Congratulations to her.
i told her i taught until i was eight months along with my son and lived to tell
A shared experience to bond over.
my brother matteo came to pick me up after in his red Mustang he has had it since 1979 and polishes it every sunday
He clearly loves that car.
he does and my brother in law dariusz teases him endlessly because he drives a Prius and thinks matteo is wasting gas
Sounds like a friendly rivalry.
very friendly sometimes too loud at dinner
Family dinners need a bit of noise.
we went for lunch at the seafood place by the water and i had to order the chicken because i cant touch shellfish my whole face swells up
That is a tough one at a seafood restaurant. Was the chicken good at least?
it was fine a bit dry
Not every dish can be a winner.
im planning a trip for next summer i want to see Newfoundland ive never been east of quebec
The coast there is beautiful in summer.
thats what everyone says
Will you travel with someone?
maybe my friend chen she lives up in Markham and likes to travel and she is good with maps i am not
A good travel partner makes all the difference.
my grandson wiremu called he made the rugby team at his high school he is so proud
That is great news. What position does he play?
no idea i dont understand the game at all lol
He can explain it to you at the first match.
oh i said newfoundland earlier for my trip but i changed my mind last night its going to be the Yukon instead chen has a cousin up there
That sounds like an adventure, and a cousin there is handy.
yes free place to stay lol
That helps the budget a lot.
i read the weather is strange there though snow in june sometimes
It can be, so pack layers.
good advice i will need a new coat
A good waterproof jacket would cover most of it.
my iPad keeps freezing when i look at coats online its so old
Restarting it sometimes helps, or clearing some storage.
i will try that
Let me know if it keeps happening.
i put on some Springsteen while i do the dishes he is still my favourite after all these years
Some musicians stay with us for life.
wait what kind of car did my brother have again
ok dishes done time for a nap
Enjoy your rest.

earlier_question.right_reply: Your brother Matteo drives a Mustang.
earlier_question.wrong_reply: Your brother Matteo drives a Prius.
